narrative_summary: Chris claimed the first-ever championship in the 10-man, standard-scoring era.
Dylan lost to Mark by 1 yard in the Sacko bowl, leading to a 5-minute stand-up comedy set at an open mic.
Dylan's second consecutive Sacko loss resulted in him serving as a butler for the league on a group cruise.
Jake lost the Sacko. Performed Freddie Mercury karaoke at home due to COVID, a move the league still considers a 'cop-out'.
Jack lost the Sacko. Failed to deliver on a month of cooking tutorials, marking the beginning of the 'Punishment Recession'.
Despite 15+ years of effort, Dylan, Will, Dan, Lac, and Fitz remain without a championship ring.
Sean holds the record for most titles with 4 rings.
